text: The U.S., China and Russia issued indentical declarations following trilateral talks in Shenzhen, outlining increased refined petroleum supply, nuclear risk reduction, UN reform and limits on ICC jurisdiction. The declarations omitted the wars in Ukraine and Iran.

meta.note: Declaratory commitments lack specified implementation mechanisms, timelines or binding obligations.

text: Walmart reported Q3 revenue of $188.84 billion, up 5.2% YoY, and global e-commerce growth of 17%, while net income fell from $6.14 billion to $4.95 billion. Prices were reduced on nearly 8,000 products, with tariff refunds partially offsetting elevated diesel costs.

meta.note: Tariff refunds constitute a cost offset; store-fulfilled pickup and delivery provide the physical-digital bridge.
